verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a programmatic SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) for scripted browser automation. It can launch remote browsers on Browserbase across regions, launch locally, or attach over CDP, with session recording for unattended runs. That points to non-interactive execution, but the evidence never documents a headless mode or a CI setup. Missing for 10: explicit headless-mode documentation, CI pipeline integration guide/examples, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: There are three ways to get one: **Browserbase (`browserbase.launch`)**... **Local (`localBrowser.launch`)**... **Attach over CDP (`localBrowser.connect`)**
Browserbase runs browsers in four regions, so you can cut latency by starting the browser near your users or your target site
Browserbase provides real-time visibility into your automation sessions
This page gets you from an empty directory to a working automation in three steps.
